title: Comparing and Measuring Lengths
description: Measure objects with equal-sized paper clips, recognize correct unit placement, compare lengths indirectly, and order objects by length.
learningFocus: Measure length with same-size units placed end to end without gaps or overlaps, compare two objects using a third object, and order three objects by length.
adultGuidance: Ask your child to check that every paper clip is the same size, touches the next clip, and lines up with the object's endpoints. On the hands-on page, use real clips of one size and discuss why the object needing the most clips is the longest; the actual counts will vary with the objects and clips used.
